matches.title: Control & Estimation Intern
matches.description:
About Us 
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
 Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

 About the Role 
 We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.
 These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

 Your mission 
 The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

 Responsibilities 
 Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control

 Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment.

 Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines.

 Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

 Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions.

 Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment.

 Candidates Requirements 
 Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus.

 Technical skills : Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus.

 Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative.

 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
